notes.title: Animations Update - Build 11262
notes.notes:
Hello,

I have been working recently on animations, and I'm pretty happy with how they came out. I was not expecting it to take such a long time though but I finally managed to finish the animations for the grenades. Hopefully, you guys will like it too!


[i][b]Oppcium Build 11262 - Patch Notes:[/b]

- In total, 17 animations have been added to the game, including 8-direction animation when crouching and walking while holding and throwing grenades

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41525603/1803419ff1096643b209d6827fa64cedd93f906f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41525603/58c123291df838662e99d7b5f733ac38cf5bc1df.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41525603/866f05693835163e6e8b60bc449d2407ffbcd4b1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41525603/b060c19bb604d129c1fbbca36d1b0a2c66857035.gif[/img]

- Throwing a grenade will restrict movement for 0.4 seconds.

- Accuracy when throwing has been increased by 47%.

- When running, the lighter and Anti-Matter/Sound-Maker grenades will automatically be placed back in the inventory. Also, while running, the player can not use the lighter and Anti-Matter/Sound-Maker grenades (a tooltip will pop-up and notify the player).

- When inspecting an item, the lighter/flashlight and the Anti-Matter/Sound-Maker grenades will now automatically be placed back into the inventory.

- Throwing grenades will now automatically break crouch/stealth movement.

- When running out of Anti-Matter grenades, it will automatically switch to the Sound-Maker and vice-versa.[/i]


[u][b]What's to come by the end of the new week?[/b][/u]

I will definitely be reworking the lighter animations from scratch and depending on time, I will either start working on adding a gun or, I will start working on reworking the puzzles in the game (to make them more interesting and engaging.)

Another problem with the game is when the player is holding one of the grenades and picks an item up. The grenade will also be thrown so the player has to manually unequip it to not throw it when interacting with pick-up items. I will fix these issues probably by the end of the week.

Oh, forgot to mention that a Steam Festival is coming up. Oppcium will most likely take part in it, so a DEMO is on the way by the 21st, I believe.

Feel free to reach out and let me know any thoughts you have about the game.
Thanks for checking the game out!

Regards,
Mikami

notes.title: Oppcium Update Build 11248 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[u][b]Oppcium Update Build 11248[/b][/u]

- Added map markers in the game. This change was added to give players more guidance and to ensure they always have a clear goal. This change was also mainly implemented to make the game more enjoyable and more accessible. The map markers are now present on the Map and they will guide the player from the start of the game to the end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41525603/14e180f1e0dc131d54f92ea2673c45d74928192a.gif[/img]

- All map markers have a tooltip related to what you have to do at a specific location.
- The game will always notify the player when a new map maker is added.

[b]Keep in mind that this change did not take out much of the difficulty of the game, it was never meant to come from puzzles, but from enemies. [/b]

- New voice lines were implemented into the game.

- Fixed a bug where Specimen-01 could not see the player properly when hiding in the courtyard behind the grassy squares with the animal statues in the middle.

- Added a map to the inside of the facility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41525603/ecbd6960988c679dca29d1d9af5868d65ddb5fbf.png[/img]

Expect more updates in the future that will further polish the player accessibility side of the game. If you encountered any issues or have any suggestions always feel free to get in touch.

- The DEMO of the game will be up this week.

notes.title: Early Release
notes.notes:
Hello.

I am making this post to let you know that I decided to release the game earlier than it was planned. 

The only problem with the launch is the steam achievement system. It does not work for one reason or another but I am looking into it.

Othan than that the game should work as intended and shouldn't have any other issues.

Good luck with your investigation!
